source_snapshot.procedure: Run 1000 AC cycles, 1000 DC cycles and 1000 warm reboots; after recovery verify all expected PCIe devices/speed/width, NVSwitch IB/MST, power sequence, BMC-scope I2C endpoints and HMC-BMC USB; source requests log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: No issues in PCIe, InfiniBand/Ethernet, power sequencing, I2C or USB checks.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60 attended and 30000 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator/PDU plus insecure DC-only ipmitool loop and generic post-checks.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for a complete 3000-transition state machine, distinct primitives, cross-domain oracles, per-cycle evidence, safe I2C and recovery.

old_problem: The proposed DC-only IPMI loop omitted AC and warm-reboot phases, embedded credentials and could not identify the first cycle that lost a PCIe/fabric/I2C/USB resource. Exact primitives, full cross-domain identity/oracle matrices, durable evidence and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The source explicitly defines three non-interchangeable phases and all post-transition domains. ED-06/18/19 prevent mechanism substitution but allow project owners to bind exact AC, DC and warm primitives and oracles before execution. The review can therefore resolve as a fully gated state machine without reducing any of the 1000+1000+1000 coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2150, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2151 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00028-V002 / 6779afce4a5e5fba was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind separate approved AC/PDU full-loss, named DC power-domain and warm-reboot primitives, ordering, dwell/readiness and one successful dry run of each; no phase substitutes for another.
Bind every PCIe endpoint/path/speed/width, NVSwitch MST/IB/Ethernet fabric, power-sequence, BMC controller/bus/address I2C and HMC-BMC USB endpoint/path/speed oracle.
Use only vendor-approved non-destructive BMC/OOB I2C reads; never sweep unknown host buses/addresses. Use secure secret handling and host verification.
Execute 1000+1000+1000 numbered atomic transitions. Persist the complete cross-domain result and artifact hashes before permitting the next action.

Preserve baseline and first-fault logs. Stop all phases on first readiness timeout, missing/downtrained device, fabric mismatch, sequence fault, I2C/USB loss, error burst, thermal/power issue or control/evidence loss; no retry.
No PDU/IPMI/reboot, PCIe/fabric/I2C/USB query, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Demonstrate deterministic recovery through 1000 full AC cycles, 1000 approved DC cycles and 1000 warm reboots, proving after every transition that all expected PCIe, fabric, power-sequence, BMC-I2C and HMC-BMC USB resources return healthy.
required_package: Signed distinct AC/PDU, DC-domain and warm-reboot primitives with dry runs, timing and readiness
Full stable-identity PCIe speed/width, NVSwitch/fabric, power-sequence, BMC-I2C and USB oracle matrices
Dedicated drained SUT, verified PDU/BMC/console controls and authorized operators
Secure bounded controller, durable per-cycle artifact storage and watchdog/hard-stop
3000-cycle authorization, zero/error tolerances and multidisciplinary recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baselines and validate one dry run per primitive. Execute 1000 numbered AC, 1000 numbered DC and 1000 numbered warm-reboot transactions using only their distinct approved controls. After every readiness transition, durably commit complete PCIe/fabric/power-sequence/BMC-I2C/USB/error/thermal evidence before the next cycle. Stop all phases on first deviation; do not clear logs or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 3000 individually recorded transitions use the correct phase primitive, meet state/readiness deadlines and restore every signed PCIe, fabric, power, I2C and USB identity/state with no disqualifying error, unsafe condition, hang or reboot anomaly beyond the intended transition.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until all primitives, identities/oracles, tolerances and recovery are signed. PASS requires every one of 1000 AC + 1000 DC + 1000 warm records accepted. FAIL on wrong/incomplete transition, readiness timeout, device/fabric/power/I2C/USB mismatch, error/thermal/power breach or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; phase summaries or later success cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until three distinct primitives, dry runs, exact oracles, counts, storage, abort and recovery are signed.
Use a dedicated drained SUT; AC remains operator-gated and all controls use secure secrets/host verification.
Use only approved non-destructive BMC/OOB I2C methods and preserve all evidence.
Stop the entire sequence without automatic retry on first deviation or control/evidence loss.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, SUT/rack/PDU/BMC identities, approvals, tools and three dry-run records
1000 AC, 1000 DC and 1000 warm action/state/readiness records
Per cycle complete PCIe identity/path/speed/width/AER and NVSwitch IB/Ethernet/MST evidence
Per cycle power-sequence, approved BMC-I2C endpoint and HMC-BMC USB path/speed evidence
Per cycle kernel/BMC/SEL/error/thermal/power artifacts and hashes
First-fault/recovery or verified final state after all 3000 cycles, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any cross-domain mismatch, timeout, unsafe condition or control/evidence loss, inhibit every later transition and preserve the first failed state. Do not switch phase mechanisms or retry automatically; invoke the signed multidisciplinary rack/power/firmware/network/storage recovery and quarantine if the complete oracle is not restored.
